description: Korean payment statement (지급명세서) filing deadline and late-filing penalty (소득세법 제164조·제164조의3·제81조의11): annual statements (interest/dividend/pension/other by end of Feb; wage/retirement/business by Mar 10), daily-worker statements and simplified statements for business/personal-service income (end of the next month), simplified wage statements (semi-annual for 2026 payments, monthly from Jan 2027 with no penalty in 2027 — 2028 for semi-annual withholding payers — if filed by the end of the month after each half). Deadlines move to the next business day. Penalty 1% (0.5% within 3 months) for annual, 0.25% (0.125% within 1 month) for daily and simplified. Estimate only; no filing.

month.description: Payment month 1-12 (not used for annual statements)
